{{Infobox |eng = Spice Berry |source = [[Foraging]] • [[Summer Seeds]] • [[The Cave|The Farm Cave]] |season = *{{Season|summer}} *{{Season|all}} ([[The Cave|The Farm Cave]]) |edibility = 10 |sellprice = 80 |xp = 7 [[Foraging#Experience Points|Foraging XP]] |color = Orange }} The '''Spice Berry''' is a [[Fruits|fruit]] found via [[foraging]] throughout Stardew Valley in the [[Summer]]. It can also be grown from [[Summer Seeds]] and can be found at any time (randomly) in the [[The Cave|Farm Cave]] if the fruit bat option is chosen. Three Spice Berries can be purchased from [[Demetrius]]' [[Desert Festival#Villager Shops|shop]] at the [[Desert Festival]] for {{Price|10|Calico}} [[Calico Egg]]s each. It can also randomly be found in [[Garbage Can]]s during Summer. Putting a Spice Berry in a [[Seed Maker]] will generate 1-3 [[Summer Seeds]]. ==Gifting== {{GiftsByItem |like=Robin,Demetrius,Linus,Pam,Kent,Leah,Leo,Shane,Elliott,Sandy |neutral=Maru,Sebastian,Pierre,Caroline,Alex,George,Lewis,Clint,Penny,Emily,Sam,Marnie,Gus,Dwarf,Wizard,Willy,Krobus |dislike=Abigail,Haley,Jas,Vincent |hate=Evelyn,Jodi,Harvey }} ==Bundles== A Spice Berry is used in the {{Bundle|Summer Foraging||y}}. ==Recipes== {| class="wikitable roundedborder" !Image !Name !Description !Ingredients !Recipe Source !Sell Price |- |[[File:Summer Seeds.png|center]] |[[Crafting#Seeds|Wild Seeds (Su)]] |{{Description|Summer Seeds}}
''(Produces 10 Summer Seeds per craft.)'' |{{Name|Spice Berry|1}}{{Name|Grape|1}}{{Name|Sweet Pea|1}} |[[File:Foraging Skill Icon.png|24px|link=]] [[Foraging]] Level 4 |{{Price|55}} |- |} ==Tailoring== Spice Berry can be used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the dyeable [[File:Shirt281b.png|24px]] [[Tailoring|Green Buttoned Vest]]. It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as an orange dye at the dye pots, located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]]. ==Quests== *The Spice Berry may be randomly requested in [[Summer]] at the [[Quests#Help Wanted Quests|"Help Wanted" board]] outside [[Pierre's General Store]] for a reward of {{Price|240}} and 150 [[Friendship]] points. ==Trivia== *Spice Berries are the only summer forageable that can be directly put into the [[Seed Maker]]. ==History== {{History|1.4|Can now be used in [[Tailoring]].}} {{History|1.6|Now obtainable during [[Desert Festival]].}} {{NavboxForaging}} [[Category:Summer Forage]] [[Category:Summer fruit]] [[de:Gewürzbeere]] [[es:Baya especiada]] [[fr:Baie épicée]] [[it:Bacca speziata]] [[ja:スパイスベリー]] [[ko:백량금]] [[hu:Fűszeres bogyó]] [[pt:Café de jardim]] [[ru:Острая ягода]] [[tr:Baharat Meyvesi]] [[zh:香味浆果]]
